tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List Digitaltableteur portfolio case studies with slug, title, category, tags and URLs.

featuredOnly.description: Only return featured case studies (default false)

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Get one case study by URL slug (e.g. dsharp-design-system, helsinki-design-system).

slug.description: Case study URL slug from list_case_studies, e.g. "dsharp-design-system"

tools.name: list_pricing_packages
tools.description: List every consulting offer on the pricing page: name, price as shown, duration, pricing model (fixed_scope, hourly, monthly or quoted) and URL.

tools.name: get_hourly_rate
tools.description: Get the hourly rates in EUR as the pricing page shows them: the standard rate and the partnership rate with its conditions. VAT excluded.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List core consulting services (design system audit, component library, tokens, AI DesignOps).

tools.name: list_expertise_stacks
tools.description: List technology and practice areas (React, Next.js, Storybook, Figma, TypeScript, etc.).

tools.name: list_audiences
tools.description: List client audiences Digitaltableteur serves (startups, scaleups, enterprise, etc.).

tools.name: get_open_hours
tools.description: Get Digitaltableteur office hours in Europe/Helsinki timezone.

tools.name: get_consulting_fit
tools.description: Map a visitor problem statement to the best-matching consulting service.

problem.description: The visitor's problem statement, e.g. "our design system has drifted from the product"

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the @dt design-system docs registry by name, keyword or UI intent. Returns budgeted briefs (import line, key props, related components) with a hint for the follow-up get call.

query.description: Component name, keyword or UI intent (e.g. "toggle")

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get the full docs-registry entry for one component: usage guidance, props, example story source and theming tokens.

tools.name: validate_component_usage
tools.description: Check proposed @dt JSX against the component contracts: prop relationships, forbidden prop combinations, deprecated props and raw-UI replacements. Pass a TSX snippet or a component name with props.

snippet.description: TSX source to check, at most 20000 characters

component.description: Component whose contract rules to check against props

props.description: Props as a JSON object, checked when component is set
